AccessAccount.description: Stable local account identity, never a display name or a transient Unix UID.

oneOf.description: Windows local SAM account. Domain/cloud accounts are not admitted.

sid.description: SID returned by the authenticated native account operation.

generatedUid.description: Persistent directory identity, distinct from numeric UID.

AccessLocalSession.description: Exact account and login session attested by the authenticated native Agent ingress.

account.description: Current account, not selected by the browser.

sessionId.description: Native login instance; logoff/switch invalidates the pending ceremony.

Secret.description: Canonical 256-bit base64url secret. Debug output is always redacted.

description: Short-lived, one-use association challenge. This is never an Identity login credential.

expiresAt.description: Server UTC expiry of this ceremony, unrelated to recovery-secret lifetime.

localSession.description: Exact native login which the Agent must recheck before confirmation.

nonce.description: One-use secret; persisted only as a hash on the server.

title: AccessChallenge
